summary: Kanzhun Ltd filed a Hong Kong Next Day Disclosure Return (Form 6-K) detailing ongoing share repurchases for cancellation. The filing lists 19 separate buyback tranches from March to April 2026, each reducing issued shares by ~0.04%-0.08%, at prices ranging from USD 6.5654 to USD 7.1427 per share. These open-market repurchases are part of a capital return program; no board recommendation or advisors are named. The filing is a routine regulatory disclosure for a Hong Kong-listed equity issuer. Watch for continued buyback execution and potential cancellation mechanics.
